content.heading: Create accounting entries by uploading documents
content.description: Giddh now supports Invoice and Bill Scanning, allowing users to quickly create accounting entries by uploading invoice or bill documents.
more_content: Create entries without typing everything manually

content.heading: Automatic extraction from the document
content.description: Instead of manually entering all the details, users can upload an invoice or bill, and the system will automatically extract relevant information from the document. Based on the scanned data, Giddh can identify and populate details such as party information, invoice number, invoice date, amount, tax details, and other relevant fields.
more_content: Other relevant fields from the scan

content.heading: Review, edit, and save the transaction
content.description: Users can review the extracted information, make any necessary changes, and then save the transaction. This significantly reduces manual data entry, improves efficiency, and minimizes the chances of human error while recording transactions.

content.heading: Example: purchase bill from a vendor
content.description: A business receives a purchase bill in PDF or image format from a vendor. Instead of manually entering all the details, the user can upload the document and Giddh will automatically extract the available information, allowing the user to verify and save the entry quickly.

faqs.question: What is Invoice and Bill Scanning in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Giddh supports Invoice and Bill Scanning so you can create accounting entries by uploading invoice or bill documents. The system extracts relevant information from the document instead of you entering all details manually.

faqs.question: What details does Giddh extract from a scanned document?
faqs.answer: Based on the scanned data, Giddh can identify and populate party information, invoice number, invoice date, amount, tax details, and other relevant fields.

faqs.question: Can I edit the extracted data before saving?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can review the extracted information, make any necessary changes, and then save the transaction.

faqs.question: Does it work for purchase bills from vendors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upload a purchase bill in PDF or image format from a vendor. Giddh extracts the available information and you can verify and save the entry quickly.

faqs.question: What file formats are supported?
faqs.answer: You can upload invoice or bill documents in PDF or image format.

faqs.question: How does scanning help reduce errors?
faqs.answer: It reduces manual data entry and minimizes the chances of human error while recording transactions.
